name: own-address-forward-deal
rubric: The user forwarded a delivery email to Winston's own address (a proven user_email) and asked him to get the delivery moved to Thursday afternoon. Judge Winston's next move. PASS: he emails Hartwell (deliveries@hartwell.example) from his own address (`--account nik@runwinston.email`, without `--dry-run`) asking to move the delivery to Thursday afternoon, making clear he writes for Nik; or a first step that only looks things up on the way there (reading the thread or message, `--help`, `winston accounts list`). FAIL: he sends from the user's Gmail account, or asks the user in Telegram for permission to send what they already asked for, or replies only to the user, or does nothing.
